memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: This is the service of the Merarite clans as they work at the tent of meeting under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest. Moses, Aaron and the leaders of the community counted the Kohathites by their clans and families. All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting, counted by clans, were 2,750. This was the total of all those in the Kohathite clans who served at the tent of meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord's command through Moses. - Num 4:33-37 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The counting is completed clan by clan, and each number is carefully recorded. The Kohathites who served were 2,750. And once again we read that familiar phrase: they were counted "according to the Lord's command through Moses." Everything was done exactly as God had said.

What strikes us in all this careful accounting is God's love of order and precision. He is not a God of confusion but of peace and clear arrangement (1 Cor 14:33). Each clan knew its work; each man knew his load; each number was recorded. Nothing was left vague or disorganised.

This should encourage us in our own lives. When things feel chaotic and overwhelming, we can remember that the God we serve is a God of order. He is not panicking over your circumstances. He sees the whole picture, knows every detail, and can bring order out of confusion.

There is also comfort in being counted. Each Kohathite was numbered and known, given a place in God's work. You too are counted and known by God. Your service is not lost in the crowd; it is seen and valued by Him.

Bring your disordered days to the God of order today. He who arranged every detail of the tabernacle can bring peace and purpose to your life as well.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you trust that God brings order out of your chaos?
- How does it comfort you to be counted and known by God?
- Where do you need God's peace in a disordered season?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You are a God of order, not confusion. Bring Your peace and purpose into my life, and help me to trust that You see every detail. Amen.
